scope: Independent reconciliation of frozen native source/model/progress/failure links, selected typed function AST modulo in-range int64 literal wrappers, and captured actual-Go values for every policy observation. The audit executes no inference or subprocess. Fixed-coordinate predictions identify a ranking cost opportunity, not a verified skipped-call optimization. Fixed arm order and whole compiler process resources do not prove causal speedup or host utilization increase.
